items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the cycle class map commutes with pushforward along the projection from the product of a nonempty equidimensional scheme with a Grassmannian (statement lines 5227-5234). The proof (proof lines 5235-5255) handles the extreme cases as projective space bundles and reduces the general case to the partial flag variety, over which both relevant morphisms are iterated projective space bundles. H2: a complete reduction in two steps.
